newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hutchison buys Motorola system for PCS.
newsitem.headline: Hutchison buys Motorola system for PCS.

text.p: Hutchison Whampoa Ltd said on Friday its 70 percent-owned Hutchison Telephone Co Ltd had on September 4 agreed to buy a DCS 1800 cellullar system from Motorola Inc at a price representing less than 3 percent of Hutchison Whampoa's shareholders' funds.
Hutchison Whampoa's shareholders' funds was at HK$58.84 billion as at December 31, 1995.
Hutchison Telephone is to purchase on a turn key basis a cellular system for the purposes of the PCS (Personal Communications Services) license which it was recently awarded, the statement said.
Motorola Inc holds the remaining 30 percent of Hutchison Telephone. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
